ambiguous-duplicate.json.description: Two candidate windows tie for best score >= 60%

collar-only-single-line.json.description: Single-line comment where line itself was edited but 3+3 collar lines match

cross-side-partial-resolve.json.description: Dual-sided anchor where new side resolves and old side orphans

deleted-file.json.description: Recorded path absent from target tree and no content candidate found

deleted-line-old-side.json.description: Old-side anchor on deleted line evaluated against tree where content has 0 matching score

drift-within-file.json.description: File edited with inserted lines: range shifted to new line numbers

elided-long-range.json.description: Elided long range (omitted > 0) matches head-32 and tail-32 verbatim

exact-blob-moved.json.description: File moved to new path with identical content

exact-path-blob.json.description: File untouched at recorded path: range and context carry over verbatim

malformed-before-null.json.description: context.before is JSON null rather than a string array; a null collar array must not decode as an empty array

malformed-commit-null.json.description: Side's commit is JSON null rather than a string; a null must not decode as the empty string

malformed-context-case-variant.json.description: context's lines key is wrongly cased ("LINES"); exact-case object keys are required, not case-insensitive struct field matching

malformed-context-missing-collar.json.description: context carries only "lines", with no "before" or "after" keys at all; none of the three defaults when absent

malformed-cross-side.json.description: Old side fails the structural pre-check (elided context shorter than 64 lines) while new side resolves exactly; scope is per-side, so the anchor resolves partial

malformed-lines-null-entry.json.description: context.lines holds a JSON null entry instead of a string; a null array element must not decode as the empty string

malformed-matching-blob.json.description: Malformed side (short-range elided context) whose recorded path and blob exactly match the target tree, pinning that the Structural Pre-Check runs before Rung 1 (exact-path-blob) rather than after

malformed-missing-commit.json.description: Side omits the required commit key entirely; anchor.schema.json requires commit, path, and blob on a side, so an absent key fails to decode as a v1 side anchor exactly as a wrongly-typed one does

malformed-omitted-null.json.description: context.omitted key is present but JSON null; presence is judged by key existence, not by a truthy value

malformed-omitted-zero.json.description: context.omitted key is present with value 0; omitted present requires omitted >= 1 and is never reinterpreted as absent

malformed-range-case-variant.json.description: range's keys are wrongly cased ("START", "End"); exact-case object keys are required, not case-insensitive struct field matching

malformed-range-end-int53-overflow.json.description: range.end is 2^63, past the +/-2^53 exact-integer bound a JSON number must decode within; start/omitted are chosen so the arithmetic would self-consistently look valid against an out-of-range float's architecture-dependent int conversion, which is exactly why the bound must be checked before converting at all (WRIT-252 round 3)

malformed-short-range-elided.json.description: Elided context (omitted > 0) on a range shorter than 64 lines; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro 1)

malformed-side-null.json.description: The new side is JSON null rather than an object; a null side must not silently decode as an empty (whole-file, path-absent) side

malformed-single-line-elided.json.description: Elided context on a single-line range against a one-line file; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro, index out of range [1])

malformed-version-string.json.description: Anchor version encoded as a JSON string ("1") rather than an integer; the whole anchor decode fails, orphaning every present side malformed (WRIT-252 repro 2)

rename-and-edit.json.description: File renamed and edited: lines found verbatim in new file

threshold-just-above.json.description: Fuzzy match scoring exactly 60% (6/10) passes threshold

threshold-just-below.json.description: Best candidate window scores below the 60% threshold (5/10)

version-not-1-undecodable-side.json.description: Integer version != 1 alongside a side that would itself fail the v1 side decode; the Version Pre-Check wins over side decode failure

whole-file-orphan.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose content changed in target tree

whole-file-resolve.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose blob matches target tree
